book.name: 2 THESALONICA
book.title: THESSALONICA Laithak Ni Na Second Thessalonians

content: Paul, Silas le Timothy te in i Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ sungah a om Thessalonica pawlpi te tung ah:
Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ tung pan thuthiamna le thinnopna sia note tungah hong om tahen.
Suapui te awng, note atu in Pathian sia a tawntung in lungdam i ko hamtang tu a hihi, banghangziam cile note upna nasiatak in khang a, khat le khat na ki itna uh zong khang hi;
Tua ahikom vawtsiatna theampo le haksatna theampo te na thuakna uh ah, na thuakzawkna uh le upna atu in Pathian pawlpi te sungah kote ka ki suangtak uh hi:

Tua thu in Pathian kumpingam atu in thuaktak hi, ci in a ki ciamte te na hi thei natu uh in, Pathian i a thutang thukhenna a kilangsak a hihi, banghangziam cile hi thu atu in note zong na thuak uh hi:
Note hong buaisak te haksatna taw thukik tu sia Pathian atu in a thutang a hihi;
Taciang no buaina a thuak te, Topa Jesus sia a thahat vantungmi te taw van pan hong kilang ciang in, kote taw na tawlnga tu uh hi,
Pathian he ngawl te le i Topa Jesus Christ i lungdamna thupha a zui nuam ngawl te sia meikuang sungah phulam kik tu hi:
Amate sia tawntung suksiatna taw Topa le a minthang vangletna mai pan in dan pia tu hi;
Ama mithiangtho te taw minthansakna ni hong thet ciang in, thu um theampo in lamdang sa mama tu uh hi, banghangziam cile kote i tettipanna sia note sungah a up uh hang a hihi.

Tua ahikom in i Pathian in note sia hi sapna ah ki phu uh hi, ci in hong cepte thei natu ahizong, taciang Ama phatna i lungkimna pha theampo sia upna i nasep vanglian taw a khuangkhim thei natu ahizong, a tawntung in kote in zong thu kong ngetsak uh hi:
Tabang in i Topa Jesus Christ min sia note sungah vanglian in hong om tu hi, taciang note zong i Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ i thuthiamna bang in Ama sungah minthanna na nga tu uh hi.
